verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Convex functions (queries/mutations/actions) run reactively when explicitly called or scheduled (cron, scheduled functions), and HTTP endpoints expose functions to external calls, but there is no evidence of native database triggers (e.g., on-insert/on-update hooks) or auth-event triggers (e.g., on sign-up webhooks) that automatically invoke functions in response to those events. missing for 10: documented database change triggers, auth event webhooks/triggers, any first-party example of event-driven automatic function execution.
